claims: Microsoft Surface devices are manufactured by Microsoft.
Microsoft Surface devices are Windows 11 touchscreen PCs.
Microsoft Surface devices are Copilot+ PCs.
Key models of Microsoft Surface devices include the Surface Pro tablet and the Surface Laptop.
Surface Pro (11th/12th Ed) is a detachable 2-in-1 tablet/laptop.
Surface Pro (11th/12th Ed) has Intel or Snapdragon processors.
Surface Pro (11th/12th Ed) offers 12-inch or 13-inch displays.
Surface Laptop (7th Ed) is a touchscreen laptop.
Surface Laptop (7th Ed) is available in 13.8-inch and 15-inch sizes.
Surface Laptop Go is a compact notebook option.
Surface Laptop Studio is a flexible laptop designed for creative professionals.
The Windows store lacks some mobile apps found on iPad or Android tablets.
Surface Pro 12-inch lacks user-accessible, removable SSDs.
Surface Pro 11/12 and Laptop 7 generally fall within the $1,000 to $2,000+ range.
